test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 19 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: As of October 2020, which of the following is a Maharatna PSU?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Coal India Limited.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• PSUs are accorded **Miniratna, Navratna, and Maharatna** Status based on their performance.
 
• These are granted by the** Ministry of Heavy Industries** and **Public Enterprises Department** of Public Enterprises.
 
• In **2009, **the "Maharatna" category for **Central Public Sector Enterprises **CPSEs was created with the goal of empowering big CPSEs to extend their operations and **become global giants** or** Indian Multinational Companies (MNCs).**
 
• CPSEs must meet the following conditions to be granted **Maharatna status**, according to government regulations:
 
 
• Having** Navratna status**.
 
• **Average annual turnover** of more than** Rs. 25,000 crore**, during last 3 years.
 
• **Average annual net worth **of more than **Rs. 15,000 crore**, during last 3 years.
 
• **Average annual net profit after tax **of more than **Rs. 5,000 crore,** during last 3 years.
 
• Should have a significant **global presence** and international operations.
 
• Listed on** the Indian stock exchange** with the **minimum prescribed public shareholding limit **under SEBI regulations.
 
 
 
• **List of Maharatna Companies__:**
 
 
• Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited (BHEL),1964
 
• Bharat Petroleum Corporation Limited (BPCL),1952
 
• **Coal India Limited (CIL),1975**
 
• Gas Authority of India Limited (GAIL),1984
 
• Hindustan Petroleum Corporation Limited (HPCL),1974
 
• Indian Oil Corporation Limited (IOCL), 1959
 
• National Thermal Power Corporation Limited (NTPC), 1975
 
• Oil and Natural Gas Corporation Limited (ONGC), 1956
 
• Power Grid Corporation of India Limited (POWERGRID), 1989
 
• Steel Authority of India Limited (SAIL), 1954
